acceptanceCriteria: Resolved with a regression test using a committed Latin-1 path, or closed by an owner decision that the current behavior stands.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 as a gap left open by decision 0394, which accepted IDX-SNAP-V0-024 (panel blocker B9, PR #219): a tracked path whose Git bytes are not UTF-8 is an index exclusion, not a repository refusal. query --task and prove --task still refuse with unsupported-query-history when commit history holds a non-UTF-8 path. The refusal is frozen under GPK-V0 with oracle parity, so a fix needs a GPK amendment that keeps parity (for example, skip the path in query history learning and disclose it) or an owner decision that the refusal stands.
title: B9 gap: query --task and prove --task refuse unsupported-query-history on a non-UTF-8 path in history
